## Checklist

- [ ] The description is a short summary of the changes (an agent session link is allowed).
- [ ] It contains no attribution footers or “generated by” trailers.
- [ ] It contains no secrets, tokens, `.env` contents, internal URLs, signing material, or private artifacts.
- [ ] It contains no pasted logs, stack traces, or environment dumps; failing jobs are referenced instead.
- [ ] Focused regressions and local `pnpm verify:local` passed on this head before the PR was opened.
